name: sammati-ledger
description: Sammati consent ledger service (monorepo root; not published as an npm SDK).

scripts.build:packages: npm run --workspace @sammati/shared-core build && npm run --workspace @sammati/webhook-utils build && npm run --workspace @sammati/server-sdk build && npm run --workspace @sammati/widget-sdk build
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run --workspace @sammati/shared-core build && npm run typecheck --workspace @sammati/shared-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @sammati/webhook-utils && npm run typecheck --workspace @sammati/server-sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace @sammati/widget-sdk
scripts.ci:verify-sdk: npm run check:workspace-deps && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run release:dry-run && npx tsx scripts/sdk-release/cli.ts smoke --skip-pack
scripts.validate:d1a: npm run build && npm run build:packages && npm run test:packages
scripts.release:pack: npm run build:packages && tsx scripts/sdk-release/cli.ts pack
scripts.release:smoke-install: npm run build:packages && tsx scripts/sdk-release/cli.ts smoke
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run build:packages && npm run test:packages && tsx scripts/sdk-release/cli.ts pack && tsx scripts/sdk-release/cli.ts verify
scripts.release:dry-run:full: npm run release:dry-run && tsx scripts/sdk-release/cli.ts smoke --skip-pack
scripts.verify:freeze-local: npm run build && npm run test:widget-token && npm run test:hosted-widget-html && npm run test:widget-route-errors && npm run test:widget-section-order && npm run verify:sample-policy-json
